```{python}
#| label: fig-ac-parametric
#| echo: false
#| fig-cap: "Mixed-signal AC parametric test setup: an arbitrary waveform generator (AWG) synthesizes the stimulus from a pattern memory, the DUT response is captured by a digitizer, and a DSP evaluates the records (FFT, filtering, averaging). A common, coherent clock for AWG and digitizer avoids spectral leakage."

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.patches import Rectangle, FancyArrowPatch


def box(ax, x, y, w, h, text, fc='#e8eef4'):
    ax.add_patch(Rectangle((x, y), w, h, fc=fc, ec='k', lw=1.0))
    ax.text(x + w / 2, y + h / 2, text, ha='center', va='center',
            fontsize=8.5)


def arr(ax, x0, y0, x1, y1):
    ax.add_patch(FancyArrowPatch((x0, y0), (x1, y1), arrowstyle='->',
                                 mutation_scale=11, lw=1.0))


fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 3.0))

box(ax, 0.2, 1.6, 2.2, 1.2, 'waveform\nmemory')
box(ax, 3.2, 1.6, 2.4, 1.2, 'AWG\n(DAC + filter)')
box(ax, 6.4, 1.6, 1.8, 1.2, 'DUT', fc='#f4e8d8')
box(ax, 9.0, 1.6, 2.4, 1.2, 'digitizer\n(filter + ADC)')
box(ax, 12.2, 1.6, 1.8, 1.2, 'DSP')
box(ax, 5.6, 0.0, 3.4, 0.9, 'coherent clock')

arr(ax, 2.4, 2.2, 3.2, 2.2)
arr(ax, 5.6, 2.2, 6.4, 2.2)
arr(ax, 8.2, 2.2, 9.0, 2.2)
arr(ax, 11.4, 2.2, 12.2, 2.2)
arr(ax, 5.9, 0.9, 4.4, 1.6)
arr(ax, 8.7, 0.9, 10.2, 1.6)

ax.set_xlim(0, 14.2)
ax.set_ylim(-0.3, 3.4)
ax.set_aspect('equal')
ax.axis('off')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```
